name: Egyptian Kings
description: The Egyptian Kings were a mixed-race street gang based in Harlem and Washington Heights, New York, active during the 1950s gang era. Allied with the Chaplains, they were one of the most prominent youth gangs of the period and gained notoriety for their role in the July 1957 stabbing death of Michael Farmer at Highbridge Park pool during a rumble with the Jesters, a white gang from Washington Heights. The gang is documented in Eric Schneider's academic work Vampires, Dragons, and Egyptian Kings.
